bottleneck.summary: The VOs3 neighbor is supported at only two of three geometric tolerances and gives weaker model agreement; preserve it without substituting it for the three-tolerance VRuOs2 admission control. Equal V fraction does not eliminate differential V-spin or Os-SOC sensitivity.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: The exact source neutral zero-applied-pressure model has positive Γ optical compression intervals and no negative retained sampled path value for target and selected control. Coarse/fine force and full stress, relaxation warnings and every q record are retained. These finite observations do not prove full-BZ or thermodynamic hull stability.

proposed_contribution.intervention: The stable SG123 role control VRuOs2→VRu2Os raises weighted ωlog by 5.09–5.34% at all ten tokens even though λ is lower at all ten; its source fixed-μ net response and independent header descriptor are positive.
proposed_contribution.next_action: Compare exact source Ru/Os-resolved α²F weights and V-projected states to determine whether altered logarithmic weighting survives the scalar-model magnetic/SOC approximation. A future failed differential-spin test would demote the hypothesis.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
